items.title_en: BIRD Lab opens applications for PhD & postdoctoral positions
items.title_zh: BIRD Lab 开放博士/博士后申请
items.body_en: We welcome outstanding scholars with backgrounds in mechanics, electronics, control or artificial intelligence to join us in advancing bioinspired intelligent robotics. We value self-driven, cooperative candidates with a strong curiosity for interdisciplinary knowledge, and we especially welcome those aiming for long-term development in academia or industry. Please send your CV and supporting materials to yuetq@sustech.edu.cn, with the email subject marked "Name + Position (Master/PhD/Postdoc/Undergraduate)".
items.body_zh: 欢迎具有机械、电子、控制或人工智能背景的优秀学者加入我们，共同推动仿生智能机器人技术的发展。我们欣赏人品端正、自驱力强、乐于协作、对跨学科知识充满好奇的候选人，尤其欢迎在学术界/产业界有长期发展意愿的朋友。请将个人简历及相关证明材料发送至 yuetq@sustech.edu.cn，邮件标题注明"姓名+申请岗位（硕士生/博士生/博士后/本科生）"。

items.title_en: Professor Zhigang Wu Delivers a Distinguished Lecture
items.title_zh: 吴志刚教授开展专题讲座
items.body_en: We were honored to host Professor Zhigang Wu from Huazhong University of Science and Technology, a well-known expert in soft robotics and embodied intelligence. He presented Soft Intelligence Lab's latest research on integrating soft robotics with embodied intelligence, followed by an in-depth discussion with lab members — an inspiring and rewarding session for everyone.
items.body_zh: 本次讲座荣幸邀请到华中科技大学吴志刚教授。吴教授是软体机器人与具身智能领域的知名专家，他系统介绍了 Soft Intelligence Lab 近年来在软体机器人与具身智能融合探索方面的最新研究成果，并与实验室成员就相关问题展开了深入交流。现场讨论热烈，同学们收获颇多。
items.home_body_en: Professor Zhigang Wu from Huazhong University of Science and Technology, a well-known expert in soft robotics and embodied intelligence, presented Soft Intelligence Lab's latest research on integrating soft robotics with embodied intelligence.
items.home_body_zh: 华中科技大学吴志刚教授（软体机器人与具身智能领域知名专家）带来专题讲座，分享 Soft Intelligence Lab 在软体机器人与具身智能融合探索方面的最新研究成果。

items.title_en: Dr. Zhiping Chai Delivers a Wonderful Talk on Mechanics and AI
items.title_zh: 柴治平博士带来了精彩的讲座
items.body_en: Dr. Zhiping Chai has been visiting BIRD Lab over the past weeks. Today he gave a wonderful talk on his PhD research at the intersection of mechanics and artificial intelligence, sharing his work and insights with lab members — an inspiring session that everyone enjoyed a great deal!
items.body_zh: 柴治平博士近期在 BIRD Lab 交流访问。今天他带来了一场精彩的讲座，分享了博士期间在力学与人工智能交叉方向的研究工作，内容充实、启发性强，现场交流热烈，同学们收获很大！
items.home_body_en: Dr. Zhiping Chai, a visiting scholar at BIRD Lab, gave a wonderful talk on his PhD research at the intersection of mechanics and artificial intelligence.

items.title_en: Invited Talk by Dr. Liming Zheng on Bioinspired Aerial Robots
items.title_zh: 邀请郑黎明博士介绍仿生飞行器研究
items.body_en: Dr. Liming Zheng shared frontier research on morphology-driven bioinspired aerial robots, inspired by gliding mammals. The talk walked through the design ideas of several generations of prototypes and the results of flight experiments — the students learned a great deal!
items.body_zh: 郑黎明博士以滑翔哺乳动物为灵感，分享了形态驱动仿生空中机器人的前沿研究。讲座依次介绍了多代样机设计思路与飞行实验结果，同学们学习到很多！
items.home_body_en: Dr. Liming Zheng shared frontier research on morphology-driven bioinspired aerial robots inspired by gliding mammals, introducing several generations of prototypes and flight experiment results.

items.title_en: Mid-Autumn Festival Gathering & BIRD Lab Research Day!
items.title_zh: 中秋节聚餐 & BIRD Lab Research Day!
items.body_en: Lab members gathered for a Mid-Autumn Festival dinner and held the BIRD Lab Research Day: everyone presented recent progress and exchanged ideas in a relaxed atmosphere — a full and enjoyable afternoon together.
items.body_zh: 中秋佳节，实验室成员聚餐共庆，并举办了 BIRD Lab Research Day：大家分享了各自的研究进展与心得，在轻松的氛围中交流碰撞，度过了一个充实愉快的下午。
items.home_body_en: Lab members celebrated the Mid-Autumn Festival over dinner and held the BIRD Lab Research Day, sharing recent progress and ideas in a relaxed atmosphere.
items.home_body_zh: 中秋佳节，实验室成员聚餐共庆，并举办 BIRD Lab Research Day，大家在轻松的氛围中分享了各自的研究进展与心得。

items.title_en: The group visited Shenzhen X-Innovation Institute
items.title_zh: 课题组参观深圳科创学院
items.body_en: The group visited the Shenzhen X-Innovation Institute and exchanged ideas with two startup companies. This visit brought students closer to the industrial frontier of robotics, and everyone deeply felt that good research cannot be done behind closed doors — it should both root in principle exploration and actively face real-world needs.
items.body_zh: 课题组参观了深圳科创学院，与两家创业公司进行了交流。这次走访让同学们近距离接触了机器人领域的产业前沿，大家深刻体会到——好的科研不能闭门造车，既要扎根原理探索，也要主动面向真实需求。

items.title_en: The group delivered an invited talk at IEEE RoboSoft 2026
items.title_zh: 课题组在 IEEE RoboSoft 2026 作邀请报告
items.body_en: Invited by Assistant Professor Quan Xiong of the University of Macau, the group delivered an invited talk titled "Water-Related Suction: Grasping, Sliding and Sensing" at the IEEE RoboSoft 2026 conference held in Kanazawa, Japan, sharing the lab's latest progress in bio-inspired adhesion research with international peers.
items.body_zh: 受澳门大学熊泉助理教授邀请，课题组在日本金泽举办的 IEEE RoboSoft 2026 国际会议上做了题为"Water-Related Suction: Grasping, Sliding and Sensing"的邀请报告，与国际同行分享了实验室在仿生吸附领域的最新进展。

items.body_en: On the eve of the Spring Festival, the lab members gathered for a hearty barbecue. No matter how busy research gets, it is important to treat ourselves well — eat well, drink well, and be ready for the new year!
items.body_zh: 春节前夕，实验室的小伙伴们聚在一起吃了顿热热闹闹的烧烤。科研再忙，也要好好犒劳一下自己——吃饱喝足，来年再战！

items.title_en: The group visited the XPENG Robotics R&D Center
items.title_zh: 课题组参观小鹏机器人研发中心
items.body_en: The group visited the XPENG Robotics R&D Center, observed the new-generation IRON robot up close, and had in-depth exchanges with senior technical experts in the industry. From laboratory to production line, from theoretical derivation to engineering implementation — the students not only broadened their technical horizons but also truly felt how hardware innovation drives the development of robotics, and benefited a lot.
items.body_zh: 课题组前往小鹏机器人研发中心实地参观，近距离观摩了新一代 IRON 机器人，并与产业界的资深技术专家进行了深入交流。从实验室到生产线，从理论推导到工程落地——同学们不仅拓宽了技术视野，也更真切地感受到了硬件创新对机器人技术发展的牵引力，受益匪浅。

items.title_en: BIRD Lab publishes octopus-inspired soft robot research in Science Robotics
items.title_zh: BIRD Lab 在 Science Robotics 发表仿生章鱼软体机器人新成果
items.body_en: The team developed an embodied-intelligence soft robot integrating grasping, perception, decision-making and actuation — providing new ideas for low-cost integration and compliant interaction in soft robotics. This work demonstrates how physical intelligence can be embedded in soft robotic systems through bio-inspired hierarchical suction, opening new possibilities for underwater and industrial applications.
items.body_zh: 研究团队开发出将抓取、感知、决策与驱动融于一体的具身智能软体机器人，为软体机器人的低成本集成与柔顺交互提供了全新思路。该工作展示了如何通过仿生层级吸盘将物理智能嵌入软体机器人系统，为水下与工业应用开辟了新的可能。

items.title_en: Snail-inspired water-enhanced sliding suction published in Nature Communications
items.title_zh: 受蜗牛启发的含水滑动吸附成果发表于 Nature Communications
items.body_en: A wall-climbing robot based on water-enhanced soft sliding suction achieves superior load-to-energy efficiency, paving the way for high-performance climbing systems. The snail-inspired approach combines soft sliding contact with regulated water secretion to deliver reliable adhesion on diverse surfaces.
items.body_zh: 基于含水软体滑动吸附的爬壁机器人实现了高负载-能耗比，为高性能爬壁系统开辟了新路径。该受蜗牛启发的方法将软体滑动接触与受调控的水分泌相结合，在多种表面上实现稳定吸附。

items.title_en: BIRD Lab publishes bio-inspired multiscale adaptive suction research in PNAS
items.title_zh: BIRD Lab 在 PNAS 发表仿生多尺度自适应吸附新成果
items.body_en: Inspired by octopus suckers, the team achieved a highly adaptive robotic vacuum suction system for end effectors, providing a solution for robot grasping on rugged, rough, dry and complex surfaces.
items.body_zh: 受章鱼吸盘启发，实现了高度适应性的机器人末端真空吸附系统，为在崎岖不平、粗糙、干燥复杂表面的机器人抓取提供了解决方案。
